verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax is a SaaS tax service, so letting users schedule recurring jobs (for example scheduled report exports or recurring tax runs) is a fair question to ask. However, nothing in the evidence documents a user-configurable recurring schedule or workflow. The TaxJar filing automation is a third-party integration for filing, not a scheduling capability, and the reports and APIs are described only as one-off or on-demand actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
